# Goal 805: Reduce long-term delegation overhead and measure consumer net value

## Problem and outcome

Goal #798 exposed repeated closeout packaging, classification partitions and release verification; prior experiments did not compare plugin use against no plugin at both model tiers. Preserve intent, recovery and independent boundary proof while removing demonstrated redundant operations. Measure actual benefit and losses honestly.

## Approved contract and execution order

The operator approved the six-item briefing and delegated finalization/execution including push, release, installation refresh and model comparison on 2026-09-06. Frozen planning: `charness-artifacts/goals/2026-09-06-long-term-delegation-net-value.md`.

1. comparison-contract: frozen neutral four-arm cooperative-resume protocol.
2. closeout-carrier: current multi-issue evidence and mixed classification.
3. release-reuse: remove duplicate preparation-time subject execution; final-state verification remains current, without cross-commit cache claims.
4. context-reuse: known-context reuse with missing/changed/uncertain routes preserved.
5. consumer-comparison: high/low candidate versus no plugin, retained initial results.
6. publish-closeout: integrate, publish once, observe installed behavior, close graph and retrospect.

## Readiness and completion

Local readiness requires integrated changes, focused scenario/test proof and applicable independent review. Context-reuse may then start its downstream pilot; pilot and final publication remain required for final acceptance. Children remain open until their actual acceptance and published carrier are observed. Parent owns the sole execution cursor. No AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md changes, #764 expansion, external repository creation or organization-wide writes. No milestone exists.

## Current frontier

One integrated [v8.5.0 release](https://github.com/corca-ai/charness/releases/tag/v8.5.0) is published and installed. Separate public/installed observations bind the retained treatment inputs and composed mixed-bundle behavior. The five implementation children closed through 0eff83280, then publication child #807 through 7d0b10f06; all six exact provider-linked children are verified CLOSED with issue-owned behavior comments. No manual child-close fallback.

The original high pair passes equal acceptance but the candidate costs 33.4 percent more time; low pure-candidate attribution remains invalid. Spec intervention, incomplete report provenance, whole-install/fresh-session limits and closeout rework remain explicit. No general efficiency or total lifecycle saving is claimed. The A1-A6 audit is charness-artifacts/goal-runs/805/parent-terminal-obligation.md and the retrospective is charness-artifacts/retro/2026-09-06-session-retro-2.md. Next is the dedicated guarded parent close with the exact graph and hash-bound final proof index; terminal observation will distinguish completion from this readiness statement.
